description: This file defines API route handlers for managing and retrieving match data in a sports engagement dashboard backend, using FastAPI. It includes endpoints for getting all matches with filtering, retrieving a specific match by ID, fetching live matches, and upcoming matches.

methods.name: get_matches( status: Optional[MatchStatus] = Query(None, description="Filter matches by status (live, upcoming, completed)"), league: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter matches by league name"), team: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter matches by team name (partial match)"), date_from: Optional[datetime] = Query(None, description="Filter matches from this date"), date_to: Optional[datetime] = Query(None, description="Filter matches until this date"), limit: Optional[int] = Query(None, description="Limit the number of results") )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch a list of matches with optional filtering parameters such as status, league, team, date range, and limit.

methods.name: get_match(match_id: int)
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve a specific match by its unique ID, raises 404 if not found.

methods.name: get_live_matches()
methods.description: Handles GET request to fetch all currently live matches.

methods.name: get_upcoming_matches(limit: int = Query(5, description="Number of upcoming matches to return"))
methods.description: Handles GET request to fetch upcoming matches, sorted by start time, with a default or specified limit.
